status: Jason prefers inline chat again. In chat is the default, with the restyled answer panel and coordinated motion. Study sheet remains available in Debug; Focus round and Card packet remain prototypes.

directions.name: Study sheet
directions.idea: A sheet over the conversation holds the complete flashcard round; dismisses back to one recap.
directions.tradeoff: Keeps the monster present but has less room than a full study screen.

directions.name: Focus round
directions.idea: Chat hands off to a dedicated full-screen flashcard session; results return to the monster.
directions.tradeoff: Most room for long questions, with a more distinct change of context.

directions.name: Card packet
directions.idea: One interactive card stack stays in the conversation; answers replace the card within the packet.
directions.tradeoff: Least navigation, but feels closest to the existing in-chat experience.

prototypeRules: Illustrative: four opening cards; 3/4 passes; a lower score leads to one three-card follow-up using missed topics. Earned time is retained; no repeat follow-up. No AI or Screen Time API is called.
verification: All three layouts inspected in browser at default width.
Focus and recap/packet layouts inspected at 320px product width.
4/4 path reaches a five-minute unlock offer.
2/4 path offers three distinct questions on the missed topics and retains 2m30s.
Three follow-up answers advance to 6m15s earned before the final recap.
Completing the three-card follow-up offers the final seven-minute rounded unlock, with no further practice gate.

implementation.debugSwitch: Profile → Debug → Study Guard v2 (Screen Time) → Flashcard style; applies next session
implementation.sheetRule: Up to 4 distinct usable cards; 75% passes; otherwise one follow-up of up to 3 cards. Prefer unseen, missed-topic cards. Small decks label review. Explicit final claim; earnings retained.
